SELECT device_code, channel_code, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct case when second_switch = 0 then alarm_type end) as alarmType, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct case when second_switch = 1 then alarm_type end) as alarmTypeNoalg, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct case when algorithm_code = '' then null else algorithm_code end) as algorithmCode, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN trigger_rule = '' THEN NULL ELSE trigger_rule END SEPARATOR ' | ') AS triggerRule FROM vm_algorithm_give_config WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND `status` = 0
AND
device_code = #{item.deviceCode} AND channel_code = #{item.channelCode}
group by device_code,channel_code

SELECT DISTINCT e.device_code, a.algorithm_code FROM vm_order_algorithms a INNER JOIN vm_order_devices e ON e.order_code = a.order_code AND e.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND a.package_code = e.package_code AND e.delete_flag = '0' WHERE a.delete_flag = '0' AND a.order_code = #{orderCode} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.industry_code = #{industryCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE vm_algorithm_give_config SET second_switch = '1', algorithm_code = NULL, algorithm_name = NULL, update_time = now(), modifier = 'order' WHERE order_code = #{orderCode} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND industry_code = #{industryCode} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vm_order_devices e INNER JOIN vm_order_algorithms a ON e.order_code = a.order_code AND e.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND a.package_code = e.package_code AND a.industry_code = e.industry_code WHERE a.delete_flag = '0' AND e.delete_flag = '0' AND a.ord_status in (0, 1, 2) AND e.ord_status in (0, 1, 2) AND a.order_code = #{orderCode} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND e.device_code = vm_algorithm_give_config.device_code AND a.algorithm_code = vm_algorithm_give_config.algorithm_code )

UPDATE vm_video_preset SET is_algorithm_identify = '0', algorithm_code = NULL, update_time = now() WHERE order_code = #{orderCode} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND industry_code = #{industryCode} AND delete_flag = 0 AND is_algorithm_identify = '1' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vm_order_devices e INNER JOIN vm_order_algorithms a ON e.order_code = a.order_code AND e.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND a.package_code = e.package_code AND a.industry_code = e.industry_code WHERE a.delete_flag = '0' AND e.delete_flag = '0' AND a.ord_status in (0, 1, 2) AND e.ord_status in (0, 1, 2) AND a.order_code = #{orderCode} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND e.device_code = vm_video_preset.device_code AND a.algorithm_code = vm_video_preset.algorithm_code )
